notes.title: Tiny Traffic V1.03 - Hotfix
notes.content:
[h3]Changes[/h3]

[/list]

notes.title: Tiny Traffic is out on Steam NOW!!
notes.content:
It's been a long ride, but I couldn't be happier! After 8 months of hard work, my relaxing puzzle game Tiny Traffic, releases on Steam!

What are you waiting for?! [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1445980/Tiny_Traffic/?beta=0]Grab a copy![/url] ːsteamhappyː
